benchmark_version.description: Human/fixture version id, e.g. synthetic-smoke.v1 or calib-zh-themes.v1

exploratory.description: When true, fixture has no calibration ground truth; Recall@K is not interpretable.

calibration.description: When true, fixture is a calibration set (manual expected Themes for Recall@K).

status.description: Calibration lifecycle: draft (may have empty quotes) | frozen (populated, immutable GT intent).

quotes.description: May be empty only for calibration status=draft scaffolds awaiting manual population.

quote_id.description: Stable research Quote id/reference (not necessarily production quotes.id).

category.description: Broad bucket, e.g. calib / smoke / exploratory.

test_purpose.description: Calibration intent, e.g. lexical_explicit | semantic_implicit | multi_theme | confusable | taxonomy_stress.

expected_theme_ids.description: Expected canonical Theme research IDs. Empty/absent = unevaluated.

expected_theme_labels.description: Optional expected canonical labels (resolved against library when ids omitted).
